report:
Debezium-Pub/Sub publish to multiple topic issue

Hi All,We have integrated Debezium CDC and Pub/Sub but facing a issue when publishing messages from single table to multiple pub/sub topics.
Problem Statement:
We want to publish messages from outbox table to multiple pub/sub topics based on the "transforms.route.topic.expression". But this is not working.
Whereas we are able to publish messages to common Pub/Sub topic(>).
Can you please let us know if Debezium has already a solution for this in place.
Attached the application.properties file.
Thanks,
Laxinandan Rajkhowa
application.properties

evidence.quote: You need to add both scripting package and the languages itself among Debezium Server JARs as these are not embedded by default." Reporter: "the issue is resolved after adding the debezium-scripting-2.6.2.Final.jar

notes: ContentBasedRouter did not route because debezium-scripting and language JARs were missing from the server classpath (documented). Later sub-issues also config (schemas.enable, decoderbufs, publication privileges).
